## Summary

**Mode derivation:** `#1` is `agent::done` → **amends** (announced, per the id-resolution rule). Planned from the delta envelope (prior Story body + acceptance + delivered file map), not a full-repo re-interrogation.

**Persisted:** [Story #3](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-25-story-scope-mandrel-a8365c59/issues/3) — *"POST /password: authenticated password change with prior-session invalidation"*, `agent::ready`, cohort `plan-run::398ed0b9`.

**Gates:** Gate #1 (intent/duplicates) and Gate #2 (review) auto-proceeded under `--yes` (headless). Critics ran before persist — consolidation + pre-mortem both `dispatch: false` (single small Story), text-hygiene clean. Dry-run passed every validator before the real persist.

**The Story captures the security-sensitive contract as load-bearing invariants:**
- `POST /password` `{newPassword}`, bearer-auth like the other endpoints; 401 resolved before body read.
- Success re-hashes with the existing `hashPassword` (plaintext never stored), durable on disk.
- **Every session issued before the change — including the requesting token — is invalidated** (single-transaction credential-update + revoke-all-sessions in the store, so the two effects can't diverge).
- Old password no longer authenticates; new password required at `/login`.
- Bad requests (missing token → 401; malformed/blank/non-string `newPassword` → 400) leave existing credentials and sessions intact.

Six acceptance criteria and e2e + typecheck verify commands. Scoped to `src/server.js`, `src/store.js`, `test/api.test.js` (`auth.js`'s `hashPassword` is reused unchanged).

Per instructions, I ran **only** the planning pipeline — no delivery, and nothing pre-staged. Deliver later with `/deliver 3`.

**Story #3 landed.** ✅

The terminal envelope reports `status: landed` — PR #4 merged to `main`, Story flipped to `agent::done`.

**What shipped** (`POST /password`, authenticated password change with prior-session invalidation):
- **`src/store.js`** — new `updatePasswordAndRevokeSessions(userId, salt, hash)`: replaces the credential and deletes all of the user's sessions in a single `BEGIN/COMMIT` transaction, so the two effects can't diverge.
- **`src/server.js`** — `POST /password` handler following the `/notes` shape: bearer auth resolved *before* the body is read (missing/invalid/unknown → 401), `{newPassword}` validated as a non-empty string (bad JSON / blank / non-string → 400 JSON), success rehashes via `hashPassword` and calls the atomic store op, returning `200 {ok:true}`. `/password` added to `knownPaths` (405 on wrong method).
- **`test/api.test.js`** — six tests, one per acceptance criterion.

**Verification** (all clean):
- Acceptance self-eval: fresh maker-blind critic scored all 6 ACs `met`; gate returned `decision: proceed`.
- `node --test`: 14/14 pass. `npm run typecheck`: clean.
- Close gates: validation / base-sync / code-review all passed. Code review: 0 critical/high/medium, 1 suggestion.
